fields.notes: MODBUS is a published protocol specification — there is no PDK, floor-plan, SDC, UPF, or DFT artifact associated with it. Any implementing IP core (open-source FreeModbus, libmodbus, pymodbus, proprietary microcontroller stacks, or vendor RTL like Xilinx Modbus IP) ships its own physical-design collateral targeted at the underlying transport hardware (UART for RTU/ASCII, Ethernet MAC + PHY for TCP). The protocol-level document is silent on every silicon-implementation concern: clock period, IO timing, area, power, scan insertion, power-domain partitioning.
